newsitem.title: USA: U.S. MTBE firms on blending demand, NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: U.S. MTBE firms on blending demand, NYMEX.

text.p: U.S. spot MTBE prices firmed this week as gasoline blenders took a bite out of tight-supplied prompt barrels ahead of the start of the driving season, players said on Thursday.
This weekend is the start of the long Memorial Day holiday weekend, which traditionally marks the beginning of the heavy driving period.
In the Gulf Coast, a 10,000-barrel deal traded for 79.50 cents on Thursday, and a similar parcel traded hands on Wednesday. The range was 1.75 cents above last Thursday.
"Blenders have come out and they are buying," said a Houston player.
In the East Coast, spot MTBE sold for 83.00 cents, about a penny higher than last week.
"The market this week was holding pretty steady with gasoline heading up," said an East Coast trader.
Trade was also dulled Thursday by an industry event in Atlantic City that took many East Coast players out of their offices. -- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631
